zh: 隔壁新搬来的邻居请我们过去烧烤。
en: Our new {neighbours|neighbors} invited us over for a barbecue.

zh: 他算不上朋友，只是个认识的人。
en: He's not really a friend, just an {acquaintance}.

zh: 谢谢你的邀请，可是我周六去不了。
en: Thanks for the {invitation|invite}, but I can't make it on Saturday.

zh: 我尽量不掺和办公室里的八卦。
en: I try to stay out of office {gossip}.

zh: 我的新发型得到了很多称赞。
en: I got lots of {compliments} on my new haircut.

zh: 昨晚我说的那些话，我欠你一个道歉。
en: I owe you an {apology} for what I said last night.

zh: 他们为了钱的事大吵了一架。
en: They had a big {argument|fight|row} about money.

zh: 你能帮我一个忙吗？
en: Could you do me a {favour|favor}?

zh: 到处都在传他们要离婚的谣言。
en: There are {rumours|rumors} going around that they're getting divorced.

zh: 聚会的主人在门口迎接每一位来宾。
en: The {host} of the party greeted everyone at the door.

zh: 我们预计聚会上会来二十位左右的客人。
en: We're expecting about twenty {guests} at the party.

zh: 我们的友谊从小学就开始了。
en: Our {friendship} goes back to primary school.

zh: 我们每隔两三年回中国看望亲戚。
en: We visit our {relatives} in China every couple of years.

zh: 下班后我要和几个哥们儿去喝啤酒。
en: I'm having a few beers with my {mates|friends} after work.

zh: 一个素不相识的陌生人帮我换了轮胎。
en: A complete {stranger} helped me change my tyre.

zh: 在这么吵的酒吧里很难好好聊天。
en: It's hard to have a proper {conversation|chat} in such a noisy bar.

zh: 他每次聚会都讲同样的笑话。
en: He tells the same {jokes} at every party.

zh: 嘴里含着东西说话是不礼貌的。
en: It's bad {manners} to talk with your mouth full.

zh: 他迟到总是找各种借口。
en: He's always making {excuses} for being late.

zh: 我对女儿许下了承诺，我一定会遵守。
en: I made a {promise} to my daughter and I intend to keep it.

zh: 你能保守秘密吗？
en: Can you keep a {secret}?

zh: 关于怎么和公婆相处，她给了我一些很好的建议。
en: She gave me some good {advice} about getting along with my husband's parents.

zh: 我们对政治的看法很不一样，但仍然是朋友。
en: We have very different {opinions|views} on politics, but we're still friends.

zh: 那只是一场误会，我从没想过要惹她不高兴。
en: It was just a {misunderstanding}; I never meant to upset her.

zh: 因为我多年前说的一句话，他到现在还对我怀恨在心。
en: He still holds a {grudge} against me for something I said years ago.

zh: 我想给她父母留下一个好的第一印象。
en: I wanted to make a good first {impression} on her parents.

zh: 我很喜欢有她作伴，和她聊天特别轻松。
en: I really enjoy her {company}; she's so easy to talk to.

zh: 你搬走以后我们要保持联系。
en: Let's keep in {touch|contact} after you move.

zh: 他们离婚了，但关系还不错。
en: They're divorced, but they're still on good {terms}.

zh: 这一轮酒我请，大家喝什么？
en: It's my {round|shout}. What's everyone drinking?

zh: 我提议为这对新人干一杯。
en: I'd like to propose a {toast} to the happy couple.

zh: 伴郎在婚宴上的致辞非常搞笑。
en: The best man gave a hilarious {speech} at the reception.

zh: 我们受邀参加二月份的一场婚礼。
en: We've been invited to a {wedding} in February.

zh: 下周是我们结婚十周年纪念日。
en: It's our tenth wedding {anniversary} next week.

zh: 周日我们家有个小型的家庭聚会。
en: We're having a small family {gathering|get-together} on Sunday.

zh: 好久不见了，下周一起喝杯咖啡叙叙旧吧。
en: It's been ages. Let's have a {catch-up|catchup|catch up} over coffee next week.

zh: 你周末有什么安排吗？
en: Do you have any {plans} for the weekend?

zh: 我不是故意要伤害你的感情。
en: I didn't mean to hurt your {feelings}.

zh: 建立信任需要很多年，失去它只要几秒钟。
en: It takes years to build {trust} and seconds to lose it.

zh: 我一点也不同情他，这是他自找的。
en: I have no {sympathy} for him; he brought it on himself.

zh: 得知您父亲去世，请接受我的慰问。
en: Please accept my {condolences} on the loss of your father.

zh: 我寄了张卡片祝贺她喜得贵子。
en: I sent her a card to say {congratulations} on the new baby.

zh: 我来给大家互相介绍一下：小梅，这位是汤姆。
en: Let me do the {introductions}: Mei, this is Tom.

zh: 波比只是个外号，他的真名叫罗伯特。
en: Bobby is just a {nickname}; his real name is Robert.

zh: 他们俩真是很般配的一对。
en: Those two make a lovely {couple}.

zh: 今年圣诞节我们要和我的岳父岳母一家一起过。
en: We're spending Christmas with my {in-laws} this year.

zh: 下个月我要去参加高中同学聚会。
en: I'm going to my high school {reunion} next month.

zh: 对那些要求太多的朋友，设定界限很重要。
en: It's important to set {boundaries|limits} with friends who ask for too much.

zh: 他讲完那个笑话之后，出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。
en: There was an awkward {silence|pause} after he told that joke.

zh: 他做什么事都迟到，这是出了名的。
en: He has a {reputation} for turning up late to everything.
